Bangumi is blocked in mainland China since May 2026, including its API. Setting up a proxy is recommended: the app then connects to Bangumi directly without any third party. A community reverse-proxy mirror can also restore browsing.
Once Bangumi is found unreachable, this switches to “Use a mirror” and stops trying Bangumi first. Switch back here any time.
Built-in mirrors: %1$s (the list updates daily and is tried in order)
Signing in and syncing collections still require the official site or your own mirror — a third-party proxy would see your credentials.
Also send sign-in and collection sync through the mirror
Your sign-in credentials and collection data go through the mirror. You accept the risk.
Let account data go through the mirror?

Mirrors are run by third parties. If you turn this on, your Bangumi credentials, collections and watch progress pass through the mirror server, and whoever runs it can see and use your account. You take full responsibility for any consequences.\n\nThe safer option is to set up a proxy: the app then connects to Bangumi directly without any third party.
I understand the risk, turn on
Use the mirror while signed in?

You\'re signed in to Bangumi. Requests made while signed in (collections, progress, ratings, and even browsing titles) go only to the official site by default, never through a third-party mirror, so they all fail when the official site is unreachable.\n\nIf you choose “Allow and use the mirror”, your Bangumi credentials, collections and watch progress pass through the mirror server, and whoever runs it can see and use your account. You take full responsibility for any consequences. To keep your account to yourself, sign out and browse through the mirror anonymously.

The official Bangumi site can\'t be reached right now, but the mirror works. You\'re signed in, and requests made while signed in (collections, progress, and even browsing titles) go only to the official site by default, so they are all failing.\n\nIf you use the mirror and allow sign-in through it, your Bangumi credentials, collections and watch progress pass through the mirror server, and whoever runs it can see and use your account. You take full responsibility for any consequences. You can also sign out and browse through the mirror anonymously, or set up a proxy to reach the official site directly.
Sign out and use the mirror
Keep signed-in requests on the official site?

You\'re using the mirror. After turning this off, requests made while signed in (collections, progress, and even browsing titles) go only to the official site, so they all fail when it can\'t be reached.

Ad-free: find, follow and watch anime all in one place, with anime info and watch progress synced to Bangumi, multiple video sources, danmaku and offline caching.
Four quick steps before you start:
Check the network and choose how to connect to Bangumi and load TMDB images
Scan a code to use your phone as a remote and keyboard
Sign in to your Bangumi account (you can skip this)
Scan the code on the right to open this TV’s Web console. Your phone must be on the same Wi-Fi as the TV. No app needed, the browser is enough:
Type on your phone to search; results open on the TV
Pick sources, pause, skip and change speed like a remote
Sign in to Bangumi; typing is easier on a phone
Anime info, collections and watch progress all come from Bangumi. First, check whether this device can reach it.
Checking, up to %1$d s left. You can choose how to connect once it finishes.
This device can reach the official Bangumi site directly.
The official Bangumi site is unreachable (common in mainland China), but the community mirror works. Setting up a proxy is the more reliable option.
Neither the official site nor the mirror can be reached. Check the network, or set up a proxy and check again.
Uses the official site and switches to the mirror by itself if the site becomes unreachable.
Browses through the community mirror without trying the official site. Sign-in only works with a personal token.
Never goes through a third party. Good if you already use a proxy or VPN.
Have your own mirror? You can enter it later under Settings → Proxy.
Backdrops on the home and details pages and episode stills come from TMDB. This checks whether this device can load them.
Checking, up to %1$d s left. You can choose once it finishes.
None of the TMDB image addresses is reachable. Set up a proxy and check again, or skip TMDB images and use covers instead.
Nothing is reachable; this device may be offline. Check the network and try again.
Uses the first reachable address in the list and moves on to the next one if it gets blocked.
Backdrops and stills use the cover instead, and TMDB is no longer requested. You can turn it back on under Settings → Proxy.
Want a specific address, or your own? You can change it later under Settings → Proxy.
Scan the code with your phone to open the Web console, then enter and save the proxy under Settings → Proxy. The check runs again by itself after you save.
